events.name: LEARN_SCATTER_FIT_UPDATED
events.description: The least-squares fit and narration after each learner action, auto-add tick, or reset — a composed listener (readout, grader) can subscribe; a harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.
events.synonyms: fit update, line of best fit, slope, intercept, correlation, r squared

events.name: LEARN_ROUND_COMPLETE
events.description: Fired once when the point that reaches maxPoints lands and the round latches done — the standard learning completion broadcast a celebration/progression sibling (fx cues, badges) rides.
events.synonyms: round complete, finished, done, completion, max points

events.name: MODE_SELECTED
events.description: Lab router broadcast naming the active mode; this instrument renders when the mode equals matchMode, otherwise renders null.

events.name: DRAG_POINT
events.description: A scatter point was dragged — id names the point, x/y its new coordinates (clamped to the axis ranges); the fit recomputes live.

events.name: GUESS_LINE
events.description: Learner dragged a guess-the-line slider — param is slope or intercept; the guess is scored against the least-squares fit.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Animate
overridableConfigKeys.description: Enable continuous redraw loop.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Auto Run
overridableConfigKeys.description: When true, INIT/MODE_SELECTED start the tick auto-adding points up to Max Points; toggle live with the Run/Pause button.

overridableConfigKeys.label: X Axis Max
overridableConfigKeys.description: Upper bound of the canvas x axis, in data coordinates; also the x endpoint the fit/guess lines are drawn to.

overridableConfigKeys.label: X Axis Min
overridableConfigKeys.description: Lower bound of the canvas x axis, in data coordinates.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Y Axis Max
overridableConfigKeys.description: Upper bound of the canvas y axis; also the ceiling curve samples clamp to and the high end of the guess-intercept slider default range.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Y Axis Min
overridableConfigKeys.description: Lower bound of the canvas y axis; also the floor curve samples clamp to and the low end of the guess-intercept slider default range.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Fit Curve Label
overridableConfigKeys.description: Legend label for the computed least-squares fit line.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Grid Step
overridableConfigKeys.description: Spacing between canvas gridlines, in data coordinates.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Guess Intercept Caption
overridableConfigKeys.description: Text prefixed to the current guess-intercept value above its slider.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Guess Intercept Max
overridableConfigKeys.description: Upper bound of the guess-intercept slider; typically set to axisYMax.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Guess Intercept Min
overridableConfigKeys.description: Lower bound of the guess-intercept slider; typically set to axisYMin.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Guess Curve Label
overridableConfigKeys.description: Legend label for the learner's proposed line, shown while guessMode is on and the fit isn't yet revealed.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Guess Mode
overridableConfigKeys.description: When true the learner's guessed line is shown instead of the fit until Reveal Fit, and the guess is scored against least squares.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: guess the line, prediction, estimate the fit

overridableConfigKeys.label: Guess Slope Caption
overridableConfigKeys.description: Text prefixed to the current guess-slope value above its slider.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Guess Slope Max
overridableConfigKeys.description: Upper bound of the guess-slope slider.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Guess Slope Min
overridableConfigKeys.description: Lower bound of the guess-slope slider.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Height
overridableConfigKeys.description: Canvas height in pixels.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Initial Points
overridableConfigKeys.description: Scatter points the canvas starts with, in axis data coordinates; Reset reseeds from this roster.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: seed points, dataset, scatter data, sample

overridableConfigKeys.label: Interactive
overridableConfigKeys.description: Enable pointer interaction on the canvas — required for dragging points.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Match Mode
overridableConfigKeys.description: When composed behind a lab router, the MODE_SELECTED mode value this instrument responds to. Empty string means standalone — render immediately on INIT.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Max Points
overridableConfigKeys.description: Cap on accumulated scatter points; Add Point and the auto-run tick stop once reached, until Reset.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Added Narration Template
overridableConfigKeys.description: Narration phrase after a point is added (button or tick), assembled as "<template> <n> — r = .., R² = ..".

overridableConfigKeys.default: Auto-adding — tick adds a new point.
overridableConfigKeys.label: Auto-Adding Narration
overridableConfigKeys.description: Narration shown after Run is pressed.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Fit Revealed Narration Template
overridableConfigKeys.description: Narration phrase after Reveal Fit, assembled as "<template> — r = .., R² = .. — guess score <score>%".

overridableConfigKeys.label: Guess Updated Narration Template
overridableConfigKeys.description: Narration phrase after a guess slider moves, assembled as "<template> <score>%".

overridableConfigKeys.label: Loaded Narration Template
overridableConfigKeys.description: Narration phrase after INIT/MODE_SELECTED/Reset load the seed points, assembled as "<n> <template> — r = .., R² = ..".

overridableConfigKeys.label: Max Reached Narration Suffix
overridableConfigKeys.description: Suffix appended to the added-point narration once maxPoints is hit.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Moved Narration Template
overridableConfigKeys.description: Narration phrase after a point is dragged, assembled as "<template> — r = .., R² = ..".

overridableConfigKeys.default: Paused — add manually with Add Point.
overridableConfigKeys.label: Paused Narration
overridableConfigKeys.description: Narration shown after Pause is pressed.

overridableConfigKeys.label: New Point Color
overridableConfigKeys.description: Fill color assigned to points created by Add Point or the auto-add tick.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Point Margin Percent
overridableConfigKeys.description: Fraction of each axis span kept clear at both ends when Add Point/the tick place a new random point, so new points never land flush against the axis edge.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Show r and R²
overridableConfigKeys.description: Show the correlation coefficient r and coefficient of determination R² under the canvas.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: correlation coefficient, r squared, goodness of fit

overridableConfigKeys.label: Show Residuals
overridableConfigKeys.description: Draw a dashed segment from each point to the fit line — the errors least squares minimizes.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Title
overridableConfigKeys.description: Title shown above the canvas.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Width
overridableConfigKeys.description: Canvas width in pixels.
